Keep the memory."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A native DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that keeps recent conversation turns, archives older history"},{"id":"p4s2","text":", and recalls exact source-backed knowledge when it matters."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文 ·
dsh.so ·
20-turn benchmark ·
Upgrade guide"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The problem it solves"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Graph Memory owns the **model-visible historical surface** without deleting DSH's event log. By defa"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ult it keeps the newest five completed user turns, removes completed reasoning/tool traces from futu"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"re requests, and recalls relevant older or cross-session source Q/A automatically."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## The 1.6 turn-memory navigation upgrade"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Before | Now |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Extract TASK / SKILL / EVENT directly from messages | Create one self-contained turn summary, then"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" derive SPO from that same sentence |
| Graph nodes could become the factual payload | Summary, SPO,"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" and communities only navigate; original question and final answer remain the evidence |
| Old memor"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ies from the active session could be filtered wholesale | Exclude only sources still visible in the "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"fresh window; archived same-session and cross-session recall share one path |
| Community expansion "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"could pull a whole neighborhood | Local LPA narrows candidates, query-time PPR ranks them, and only "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"matched Q/A is recovered |
| DSH retained complete tool and reasoning traces | Completed turns retai"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"n question + final answer; older prefixes collapse to one fixed marker |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Writing one completed turn costs exactly **one auxiliary LLM call**. Community detection and PPR are"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" local. There are no hard-coded node/edge counts, semantic direction gates, or JSON repair that turn"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"s invalid output into accepted data. Read the complete design, source map, and porting sequence →"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Measured first"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Real 20-turn GLM-5.2 run | Historical native DSH baseline | Latest Graph Memory | Change |
|---|--"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"-:|---:|---:|
| T20 first request | 56,998 tokens | **11,008 tokens** | **−80.69%** |
| T20 model-vi"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"sible messages | 171 | **21** | **−87.72%** |
| T01–T20 first-request context | 532,451 tokens | **1"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"65,896 tokens** | **−68.84%** |
| All measured tokens¹ | 2,487,776 | **2,327,728** | **−6.43%** |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"¹ The latest candidate includes 166 main-agent requests, 20 turn extractions, and 41 embedding reque"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"sts; the historical baseline made 77 main requests. DSH commits and nondeterministic tool loops diff"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"er, so this is not a simultaneous strict A/B. T11, T19, a"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"nd T20 automatically recalled out-of-window memory with exact source question and final answer."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Read the Markdown benchmark, per-turn data, method, and limits →"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Memory survives the context window"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The graph is a **navigation layer**, not a replacement for evidence. `TASK`, `SKILL`, and `EVENT` no"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"des point back to the original user question and final visible answer; recalled context includes tho"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"se exact source messages."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install on DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`1.6.0-beta.17` fixes producer attribution on DSH 0.1.7+ / Session V4 (#113), extraction on models t"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"hat cannot use `off` (#117), and configurable SQLite lock waiting. Fix details and recovery instructions (Chinese) →"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Node.js `22.13+` · no DSH fork · until npm `1.6` is published, install the pinned GitHub release:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The npm registry still serves the old `1.5.8`; do not use it to validate DSH. | Lightweight extraction | Only the user question and final answer; strict structured "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"tool contract; no reasoning/tool transcript ingestion |
| Query-first recall | Vector Top-K with FTS"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"5 fallback; exact source Q/A travels with graph hits |
| Durable memory | Local SQLite, stable prove"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"nance, cross-session and cross-project recall |
| Failure behavior | Invalid extraction is quarantin"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ed; foreground conversation continues; bad data is not repaired or persisted |
| Host support | Nati"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ve DSH/Cordis adapter; maintained OpenClaw Context Engine adapter |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Optional embeddings"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Graph Memory supports OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoints. | `gm_search` | Explicit gr"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"aph-memory search |
| `gm_record` | Deterministically persist a `TASK`, `SKILL`, or `EVENT` |
| `gm_"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"stats` | Graph and retention receipts |
| `gm_maintain` | One bounded maintenance tick |
| `gm_retry"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"_extraction` | Explicitly retry pending or quarantined extraction |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Automatic recall needs no tool call. Extraction may use a dedicated model via `GRAPH_MEMORY_LLM_PROV"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"IDER` and `GRAPH_MEMORY_LLM_MODEL`; optional reasoning and output controls are `GRAPH_MEMORY_LLM_REA"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"SONING_EFFORT` and `GRAPH_MEMORY_LLM_MAX_TOKENS`."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Without an explicit effort, extraction reads the exact model capability: prefer `off`, otherwise the"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" host's first advertised effort, or omit the field on non-reasoning models.
